title: Chandrayaan-2's Orbiter, Still at Work

segments.say: An Indian spacecraft reached the Moon in twenty nineteen and was meant to work for one year. ISRO now expects it to last about seven.
It launched in July twenty nineteen. The lander, Vikram, separated in September, but crashed four days later after a software glitch.
NASA's own Moon orbiter later photographed the spot where Vikram came down. The Indian orbiter, though, carried on.

anim.title: The orbiter
items: Sharpest camera of any Moon mission

segments.say: It circles the Moon over the poles, about a hundred kilometres up, with eight instruments. Its camera can see details as small as thirty centimetres.

anim.title: What it has found
items: Argon-40 in the thin lunar air
A big solar flare watched in 2024

segments.say: It has mapped sodium on the surface, detected argon-forty in the Moon's thin atmosphere, found chromium and manganese, and watched a large solar flare in twenty twenty-four.
In twenty twenty-three it also served as a communication relay for Chandrayaan-3.
For GS Three, remember this: a mission can miss one goal and still deliver years of science.

sources: ISRO, Chandrayaan-2 mission page (isro.gov.in/Chandrayaan_2.html): 100 km lunar polar orbit; Vikram separated 2 September 2019; eight orbiter instruments; OHRC has the best resolution (0.3 m) of any lunar orbiter camera; expected life of about seven years against a planned one year

Wikipedia, 'Chandrayaan-2' (summary read): launched 22 July 2019 on LVM3-M1; Vikram crashed 6 September 2019 after a software glitch; the orbiter relayed for Chandrayaan-3; CLASS mapped sodium; CHACE-2 detected argon-40; chromium and manganese detected; XSM and CLASS observed a May 2024 solar flare

quiz.q: What did the Chandrayaan-2 orbiter do for Chandrayaan-3?
quiz.why: In 2023 the orbiter relayed communication for the Chandrayaan-3 lander.

quiz.q: Roughly how high above the Moon does the orbiter fly?
quiz.why: ISRO gives a 100 km lunar polar orbit.

quiz.q: Which Chandrayaan-2 instrument is the high-resolution camera?
quiz.why: OHRC, the Orbiter High Resolution Camera, resolves about 0.3 m.

reviewNote: Facts were read against ISRO's Chandrayaan-2 page; launch date, crash cause and science results come from the Wikipedia article and should be checked against ISRO before approval. The 'Relay' ring is decorative (full ring). Moving facts: the orbiter's remaining life and its science results keep changing.
